# Spänd väntan på techjätten – oljepriset faller vidare

**Feed**: efn-borsfrukost  
**Published**: 2026-08-26  
**Market Sentiment**: Mixed

⏱️ **Time Horizon Key**: ST = <3 months | MT = 3-12 months | LT = >12 months

---

## Episode Thesis

EFN Morgon previews a busy US day: US PCE inflation data, Nvidia's Q2 earnings after the close and Salesforce's report, with Jackson Hole on Friday. Oil has fallen from 94 to about 85 USD on signs of easing Iran/Hormuz tensions, which the hosts see as good for the economy and US inflation. On the Swedish side they review reports from Smart Eye (strong automotive growth, narrowing losses) and Inission (profit doubled, margin up), preview BioArctic, and note weak consumer signals from US footwear and sporting-goods retail.

---

## Universe Stocks

### 🟠 NVDA — Nvidia | **WATCH** (Moderate)

**Sentiment**: Mixed | **Time Horizon**: ST  
**Confidence**: 50%

Q2 report sets the market mood. A Q3 sequential sales rise of 13bn+ USD would count as a beat; 9-10bn would be seen as weak. 59/62 analysts rate it buy.

#### Reasoning

Hosts treat the report as the key catalyst for the tech-driven market. Cited analyst consensus is overwhelmingly buy, and Nvidia has beaten its own guidance five quarters running. Rising competition, for example from OpenAI's own chips, tempers the near-monopoly view. The hosts take no position of their own; this is a watch ahead of the event.

#### Sell Triggers

- Q3 sequential revenue guide of only 9-10bn USD
- evidence of market share loss to custom chips

> *"59 av 62 analytiker har köp-alout-performer-rekommendation på Nvidia."*

---

### 🟠 SEYE — Smart Eye | **WATCH** (Weak)

**Sentiment**: Positive | **Time Horizon**: MT  
**Confidence**: 50%

Sales up about 50%, automotive up 120%+, losses narrowing and design wins converting. Stock up 75% since April.

#### Reasoning

The hosts are positive on the automotive deliveries finally coming through from years of design wins. It is still loss-making and burns cash, and the stock has already run strongly, so this is a watch rather than a buy.

#### Sell Triggers

- automotive growth slows
- losses fail to narrow further

> *"Martin Krantz, vd, talar om att man nu skördar frukterna av alla de här otaliga designwins"*

---

### 🟠 INISS-B — Inission | **WATCH** (Weak)

**Sentiment**: Positive | **Time Horizon**: MT  
**Confidence**: 40%

Profit doubled, operating margin rose to 6.3% from 4.3%, and the stock is up 85% in a year.

#### Reasoning

A host who skimmed the report calls it a successful company with strong earnings momentum and margin expansion. This is a brief mention with no explicit recommendation.

#### Sell Triggers

- operating margin reverses
- contract manufacturing demand weakens

> *"Det går ganska bra för det här bolaget. De dubbla vinsten."*

---

### 🟠 BIOA-B — BioArctic | **WATCH** (Weak)

**Sentiment**: Positive | **Time Horizon**: LT  
**Confidence**: 40%

Leqembi sales growing about 60%, about 2bn SEK in cash, many promising projects, and a report due at 08:00.

#### Reasoning

The host expects a weaker quarterly result because of last year's milestone comparison, but sees R&D and the pipeline as the next phase and calls it a Swedish pharma success.

#### Sell Triggers

- Leqembi growth slows markedly
- pipeline setbacks

> *"Jag tror det är runt 2 miljarder i kassan och väldigt många spännande projekt."*

---
